description: A library whose public struct holds a header-only SIMD dependency's vector typedef, rebuilt for a wider ISA (intel/xvec, -mavx2 against -mavx512f): the dependency's ABI-tag instances, hidden-friend operators, inline tables, member typedefs and weak template instances all change, the library's own surface does not. They are still reported, but out of contract (dependency_internal_unreachable), so the comparison does not gate on them.
field_report: intel/xvec header-only dependency compared with headers (follow-up to ADR-089 / PR #1775)
